answer_text:
Several affordable CRMs now include email sequences without a separate sales-engagement tool. Good choices:

1. Northwind CRM - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
2. Tallyfox Starter - built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.
3. Pipewell - easy to adopt, but email features cost extra.

Trial Northwind CRM and Tallyfox side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
